CoW Swap is a decentralized exchange built on CoW Protocol. CoW Swap settles trades through batch auctions. CoW Swap relies on competing solvers to find settlements. CoW Swap aims to protect traders against MEV such as sandwich attacks. CoW Swap runs on the Ethereum blockchain and other public blockchains.

COMP is the governance token of the Compound lending protocol. COMP is an ERC-20 token on the Ethereum blockchain. COMP holders use COMP to vote on protocol governance proposals. COMP was distributed to users of the Compound protocol as liquidity mining rewards.

Rari Capital is a DeFi protocol on the Ethereum blockchain. Rari Capital offers Earn vaults that aggregate yield across lending protocols. Rari Capital offers Fuse, which enables permissionless lending pools. Rari Capital uses the RGT token for governance.

Pancake Bunny Finance is a yield optimizer protocol on the BNB Smart Chain. Pancake Bunny Finance automatically compounds yield for users who stake liquidity tokens. Pancake Bunny Finance uses the BUNNY token as its reward token. Pancake Bunny Finance suffered an exploit in May 2021 involving manipulation of the BUNNY token price.

LFJ is a decentralized exchange on the Avalanche blockchain. LFJ was formerly known as Trader Joe. LFJ uses a Liquidity Book automated market maker design.
